$comment: Draft from docs/portfolio.md, 'Contracts'. The fields follow what ad-copy's `adcopy compute check` prints today (a candidate, its placement and field, its length counted the placement's way, its status and findings), read from its main branch, plus the selling-point direction each proposal tests, which the pack's ledger will add (its M2). The pack aligns to this schema once it is agreed.
title: copy.proposals/1
description: Candidate ad text, one per placement field, each checked against that placement's spec and the client's banned terms, with the selling-point direction it tests. ad-copy writes it; operators read it to build their ads, and asset-handoff reads it for the rows of the client's form.
x-rules: An operator uses only a proposal whose status is clean, or to_decide after a person decided; a blocked one is never used.
length is counted the way the placement counts (a double-width character may count as 2), not as plain characters, unless the finding says the rule was not sourced.
A proposal's id is stable: the same text keeps its id in every document that lists it.
An absent optional key means unknown, never null and never an empty string.

producer.description: The pack that wrote the document (its CLI word).

produced_at.description: When the document was written: ISO 8601 with its zone.

market.description: The market and language the texts are written for (the hub's market word).

proposals.description: The candidate texts; empty when there are none.

ad.description: Which ad the text belongs to, when several texts make one ad (the headlines and descriptions of one responsive search ad).

placement.description: The placement the text is for, in ad-copy's word (for example google_rsa).

field.description: The field of the placement the text fills (headline, description, primary_text...).

text.description: The text, as it would run.

length.description: The text's length counted the way the placement counts it.

status.description: clean: nothing found; to_decide: a person decides (a recommended limit passed, a draft rule matched); blocked: it cannot be used as it is.

direction.description: The selling-point direction the text tests, in the client's words, so results can be read by direction.

findings.description: What the check found; empty when the status is clean.

check.description: The producer's code for the finding.

severity.description: block: the text cannot be used; warn: a person decides.
